fusions.name: Butting Stock
fusions.desc: Rams the target with your stock and fires point-blank, dealing 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Word
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 26 damage and ignores armour. Its damage rises 8% per tenth of your own health already lost (max +40%).

fusions.name: Crag Retort
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Hardheaded Reserve
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 5% more damage per stack (38% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
